question: If the difference between the circumference and radius of a circle is 37 cm, then the area of the circle is
solution:
GIVEN:

circumference - radius = 37 cm

FORMULA USED:

circumference of circle = 2πr

area of circle = πr² 

CALCULATION:

A.T.Q

2πr - r = 37

r(2 × 22/7 -1) = 37

r = (37 × 7)/37

r = 7 cm

Area = 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 154 cm² 

∴ area of the circle is 154 cm²
